parent_objective: build a gate utility matrix from existing artifacts so historical gates can be classified before cleanup
blocked_by: gate cleanup and paper-route training need evidence about which gates catch known bad candidates and which gates false-reject good candidates
supersedes: using an unaudited full historical gate stack as a permanent blocker
demoting row-specific gates without candidate-based utility evidence
invalidates: claiming gate cleanup from a design-only milestone
using private holdout to tune gate classification
running replay or training inside the utility matrix milestone

public_gates: M1185 may inspect existing public artifacts, docs, manifests, and scoreboard rows
M1185 must not run candidate replay
M1185 must not demote or delete gates
M1185 must not train actor weights
M1185 must not use private holdout
M1185 must not change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not demote or delete gates
do not classify a missing-path candidate as pass or fail
do not treat a not-applicable non-checkpoint artifact as a driver checkpoint
do not claim paper evidence from matrix construction

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_process: gate utility and engineering-logic cleanup matrix
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: populates the M1184-designed candidate and gate-stack matrix from existing artifacts without replay or training
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process evidence only; provisional gate classification recommendations and no active demotion, promotion, PPO, private-holdout, driver-performance, or paper-result claim
stop_condition: stop if candidate classes lack known good or known bad examples
stop if missing paths are silently treated as pass or fail
stop if the matrix starts replay, training, PPO, promotion, or private holdout
stop if the matrix changes actor inputs
fallback_plan: if inventory is insufficient, route to a candidate inventory milestone
if a gate command cannot be resolved from docs, classify command_status as unresolved rather than demoting the gate
if known bad coverage cannot be scored, keep the gate as extended-regression until a later executable audit
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1184 audit design requires a utility matrix before historical gates can be cleaned up or kept as permanent active blockers

training_stage.stage_objective: build gate utility matrix from existing artifacts
admission_evidence: M1184 defines candidate classes, gate stacks, and classification rules
M1182a requires gate utility audit before paper-route cleanup
M1183 confirms source-rich metadata infrastructure is smoke-ready but not proof-ready
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review artifacts
next_stage_criteria: missing candidate paths and not-applicable rows are explicit
follow-up cleanup or inventory route is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1185 is a process matrix over existing artifacts and does not test current-frame substitution or history necessity.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If the matrix finds insufficient candidate evidence, route to inventory or executable audit instead of weakening self-identification standards.
allowed_claims: no self-identification, driver capability, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: Existing artifacts are sufficient to populate a first gate utility matrix that separates core, research-only, extended-regression, legacy, and deprecated gates without running replay or changing gates.
success_criteria: candidate classes include good, known bad, near-miss, and null/no-op rows
gate classification recommendations are reported with reasons
missing paths and not-applicable rows are explicit
no gate demotion, candidate replay, actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input change occurs
failure_criteria: matrix demotes or deletes gates instead of recommending classifications
missing paths are silently treated as pass or fail
not-applicable rows are treated as driver passes or failures
candidate replay, actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input change starts

commands.name: build_gate_utility_matrix_from_existing_artifacts
commands.command: construct docs/gate-utility-matrix.md and runs/m1185_gate_utility_matrix/*.csv from existing docs, manifests, scoreboard, and run summaries only

decision_rule: M1185 passes if it builds the gate utility matrix and provisional classification recommendations from existing artifacts while preserving all M1184 guardrails.
